mapper.select: SELECT A.UPDATE_TIME AS updateTime, A.SUP_FREQUENCY as supFrequency, W.FREQUENCY as frequency, A.PORTFOLIO_ID, A.IND_ID as indId, B.IND_NAME as indName, B.SUP_TYPE as supType, A.SUP_DATE as supDate, A.SUP_VAL as supVal, A.WARN_COND as warnCond, A.APPROVE_COND as approveCond, A.FOUL_COND as foulCond, A.SUP_STAT as supStat, A.FOUL_DAYS as foulDays, A.SUP_UNITE_STAT as supUniteStat, A.MATH_PROCESS as mathProcess, B.MEMO as memo, B.IND_TYPE as indType, (CASE WHEN C.PORTFOLIO_LEVEL = #{PORTFOLIO_LEVEL_01,jdbcType = VARCHAR} THEN (SELECT D.PORTFOLIO_NAME FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO D WHERE D.PORTFOLIO_ID = A.PORTFOLIO_ID) ELSE (SELECT E.PTL_BAG_NAME FROM RSK_PORTFOLIO_PACKAGE E WHERE E.PTL_BAG_ID = A.PORTFOLIO_ID) END ) groupName, (SELECT count(1) FROM RSK_ISUP_POINT_DET_VAL t WHERE t.IND_ID=A.IND_ID AND T.PORTFOLIO_ID=A.PORTFOLIO_ID AND T.SUP_FREQUENCY=A.SUP_FREQUENCY AND T.SUP_DATE=A.SUP_DATE) AS mxCount FROM RSK_ISUP_POINT_VAL A INNER JOIN RSK_PORTFOLIO_INDICATOR C ON C.PORTFOLIO_ID = A.PORTFOLIO_ID AND C.IND_ID = A.IND_ID INNER JOIN RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR B ON B.IND_ID = A.IND_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO D ON D.PORTFOLIO_ID = A.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN RSK_PORTFOLIO_PACKAGE E ON E.PTL_BAG_ID = A.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN (select A.PORTFOLIO_ID AS ID,COUNT(A.SUP_STAT) AS frequency from RSK_ISUP_POINT_VAL A WHERE A.SUP_STAT <> 'NORMAL' group by A.PORTFOLIO_ID) W ON W.ID = A.PORTFOLIO_ID INNER JOIN ( SELECT A.PORTFOLIO_ID, A.IND_ID, MAX(A.UPDATE_TIME) AS updateTime FROM RSK_ISUP_POINT_VAL A GROUP BY A.PORTFOLIO_ID, A.IND_ID) M ON A.UPDATE_TIME = M.updateTime AND M.PORTFOLIO_ID = A.PORTFOLIO_ID AND M.IND_ID = A.IND_ID
